pages.retelling: For one towel, I say “It is a towel”; a is needed in that phrase.
pages.what_i_do_now: When I name one towel, I will say “It is a towel,” including a.

pages.retelling: For one curtain I say a curtain, but for several curtains I say curtains without a and use “They are curtains.”
pages.what_i_do_now: For several curtains, I will say “They are curtains.”

pages.retelling: One pillow is “It is a pillow,” while several pillows are “They are pillows,” with no a.
pages.what_i_do_now: For several pillows, I will say “They are pillows” and leave out a.

reason: The revised opening is clear, and all three pages remain understandable in one read with a concrete phrase to use.
